activities.name: 20-20-20 Eye Rest
activities.why: Reduces digital eye strain, ciliary muscle spasm, and dryness.

steps.t: Look at something about 20 feet (6 m) away
Blink slowly and fully 10 times to refresh tear film
Follow the figure-8 dot with your eyes. Keep your head still
Close your eyes gently, cup palms over them, and relax

activities.name: Neck & Shoulder Stretch
activities.why: Relieves upper trapezius and cervical stiffness from hunching over spreadsheets.

steps.t: Tilt your head to the RIGHT, drop left shoulder, hold
Tilt your head to the LEFT, drop right shoulder, hold
Roll your shoulders backward in large, slow circles
Interlace fingers, push palms toward ceiling, stretch tall
Chin tuck: pull chin straight back (make a double chin), hold

activities.name: Wrist & Finger Care
activities.why: Protects carpal tunnel and tendons against rapid numpad/Excel shortcut strain.

steps.t: Rotate both wrists smoothly in outward and inward circles
Spread fingers wide apart for 3s, then make a gentle fist
Prayer stretch: palms together in front of chest, lower hands
Extend arm, gently pull fingers back toward body (both hands)
Shake out your hands loosely like shaking off water

activities.name: Water + Walk
activities.why: Hydration plus movement to restart lower-limb circulation and mental clarity.

steps.t: Pour and drink a full glass of water slowly
Walk around the room, office corridor, or balcony
Look out of a distant window and let your eyes unfocused

activities.name: Back & Posture Reset
activities.why: Counteracts lumbar disc pressure and rounded shoulders from long sitting.

steps.t: Stand up. Place hands on lower back and arch back gently
Seated or standing thoracic twist: rotate torso left, then right
Reach both arms up, then side-bend gently left and right
Sit back down: hips all the way back, feet flat, spine tall

activities.name: Calm Breathing (4-4-6)
activities.why: Activates the parasympathetic nervous system to lower cortisol during deadlines.

steps.t: Follow the breathing orb: Inhale 4s, Hold 4s, Exhale 6s

activities.name: Navy SEAL Box Breathing (4-4-4-4)
activities.why: Sharpens focus and stabilizes heart rate before complex reconciliations or meetings.

steps.t: Follow the square perimeter: Inhale 4s, Hold 4s, Exhale 4s, Hold 4s

activities.name: Desk Mobility & Pushups
activities.why: Fires up chest, core, and glutes to wake up your metabolism.

steps.t: 12 Incline Desk Pushups (hands shoulder-width on sturdy desk edge)
12 Bodyweight Squats (sit hips back, chest up, knees tracking toes)
20 Standing Calf Raises (pause 1s at the top for blood flow)
Deep recovery breaths & shake out arms and legs
